topic: What trade-offs exist between reflector aperture size and feed element redundancy in robust antenna design?
response: Reflector aperture size and feed element redundancy trade off between gain and robustness. Larger apertures increase gain but may require more feed elements, increasing complexity and potential failure points.
reference_context: Reflector antenna design for satellite communications involves balancing aperture size and feed element redundancy to achieve robustness against feed failures.
